Отдельная операция включает USB ADB для: This separate operation enables USB ADB for diagnostics, including on a prepared modem with working SSH. Normal management uses SSH. This button does not install the agent, VPN or SSH, generate keys, or change passwords. The modem may reboot. Opening this help does not run anything.
Нужны USB-кабель с передачей данных, адр:
Use a USB data cable, the modem address and its stock Web password. The agent password is not needed. Working SSH does not skip the ADB check. After Web login, the IMEI and firmware versions are checked; the bundled adb is verified by SHA-256. devices -l and, when needed, -d get-serialno identify the USB modem.

Success requires real shell checks: root, ARM64, CID, firmware and diag-router hashes, and a matching Web identity. Verification is repeated. If ADB already works, no backup, USB switch or reboot is needed. An unknown hash does not prove installation or NV-write compatibility; this operation only confirms diagnostic access.
Перед изменением сохраняются свежий исхо:
Before a change, the original fresh configuration backup, identity and SHA-256 are saved in ADBAccessBackups/<UUID>. adb-access-pending.json is separate from preliminary preparation. An unfinished installation or another operation blocks activation.

If the stock zwrt_bsp.usb.set method is advertised, mode=debug is sent. If method listing is unavailable, the historical fallback is permitted only for CN MU5250 through B27. Explicit absence of the method means it is skipped. Early firmware requires Skip firmware check; this does not bypass installer restrictions. Actual root USB ADB is checked for up to 90 seconds. A command with an uncertain response is not sent again.
Если штатный USB debug не помог, приложе:
If stock USB debug does not help, the app signs in to the same Web endpoint again and saves a new fresh backup. Restoration is permitted only for verified B31. Decryption, gzip, tar, the inner MD5 and archive contents are verified; only the ADB boot line in etc/rc.local changes. After upload, SHA-256 and identity are checked again. Restore intent is saved before the single request; the modem will reboot.

If the ADB line is already present in the verified fresh backup, no restore is repeated: the diagnostic button requests one stock reboot to apply the existing configuration. This has a separate saved intent. An already working ADB channel never triggers a reboot. The B31 restore method is not used on B02 or unknown firmware.
После восстановления или перезагрузки пр:
After restoration or reboot, the app waits up to four minutes for USB ADB and verifies root and identity. A Web response alone does not mean success. offline, unauthorized, missing permissions, local adb errors and modem mismatches are reported separately.

If the reply is lost or the modem is still booting, Resume ADB activation reads the saved journal and only repeats verification after an already requested restore or reboot. This resume needs neither Web nor its password. Uncertain commands are never automatically repeated. Completion evidence and backups remain local; the active journal is removed only after ADB is confirmed.

The application connection status remains tied to SSH. Previously connected SSH is checked again after the operation; a lost connection cannot remain green. ADB is available to diagnostics and firmware research. Automatic ADB activation is disabled while the terminal is open.
